title: Emma's Rugby Practice
body: On Saturday afternoon, Emma stood on a wet rugby field with her school team. Their coach, Ben, asked them to practice passing the ball before their match. Emma was nervous because she often dropped the ball when she ran. Her friend Jack told her to hold it with both hands and move slowly at first. They practiced near the white line while the other players waited behind them. After three tries, Emma caught Jack's pass and ran toward the end of the field. She passed the ball back to Jack, and he scored a try. Ben smiled and said that good teamwork was more important than running fast.
